mapper.select: select from roam_session where member_id = #{owner} and id = #{id} and status = 1

select count(*) as trips, case when count(distance_m) = count(*) then coalesce(sum(distance_m),0) else null end as distanceM, case when count(finished_at) = count(*) then count(distinct date(finished_at)) else null end as days, case when count(shop_count) = count(*) then coalesce(sum(shop_count),0) else null end as shops from ( select distance_m, finished_at, case when json_valid(finish_result_json) then case when json_type(json_extract(finish_result_json,'$.sessionShops')) = 'INTEGER' and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(finish_result_json,'$.sessionShops')) as decimal(30,0)) >= 0 then cast(json_unquote(json_extract(finish_result_json,'$.sessionShops')) as decimal(30,0)) else null end else null end as shop_count from roam_session where member_id = #{owner} and status = 1 ) facts
